songQuiz.title: Song Quiz
songQuiz.subtitle: 30-second preview · pick the right title
songQuiz.guestHint: No login needed — scores stay on this device. Log in and they join the site-wide board.
songQuiz.intro: Thirteen franchises (Touhou doujin circles, Kamen Rider and Ultraman split by Showa/Heisei/Reiwa, decade hits, internet memes, popular IPs, maimai DX originals and its collab songs) and 72 groups. Every song plays a 30-second preview before you pick the right title out of four. Four difficulties: Easy (5 songs), Normal (10), Hard (20) and Expert, which draws from the whole catalog with three hearts — every miss costs one. Faster answers score more, and the site-wide board weights scores by difficulty.
songQuiz.guide: You can replay the preview as often as you like. Wrong answers stay hidden until you submit.

easy.name: Easy
easy.desc: Five songs, a two-minute round — good for learning the ropes.

normal.desc: Ten songs per round, the usual pace.

hard.desc: Twenty songs in a row — how well do you really know them?

expert.name: Expert
expert.desc: The whole catalog at random. A wrong answer costs a heart; when all three are gone the round ends.

rules.title: How Song Quiz works

quick.listenText: Apple provides a single 30-second preview per song, and you can replay it as often as you like.
quick.optionsText: Choose the right title out of four; the correct slot is reshuffled every round.
quick.speedText: Answering inside the 30 seconds earns a speed bonus that shrinks as time passes.
quick.heartsText: Expert draws from the whole catalog; a wrong answer costs a heart and the round ends once all three are gone.

rules.scoreText: A correct answer is worth 100 points plus up to 60 in speed bonus, multiplied by the difficulty factor; a flawless round adds 250 × factor.
rules.rankText: Each difficulty has its own board and only your best round counts. Guest rounds never appear.
